description: NDC 10/11-digit converter — Convert and validate National Drug Codes: 10-digit (4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1, hyphenated or not), 11-digit 5-4-2 billing format, or a 12-digit UPC barcode. Resolves ambiguous un-hyphenated codes against the FDA NDC Directory and returns the HIPAA/NCPDP billing NDC plus product (brand, generic, strength, labeler, package). Up to 20 comma-separated. Params: ndc=; optional verify=0 for offline conversion only. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_ndc_convert
